repos_data.description: Workflow management system for the automated and distributed analysis of large-scale experimental data.

NetChan is not a new transport. It starts from a simple physical observation: communication is coordination.  In the real world, things move, ownership moves, and the right to act moves with them. NetChan brings that same model into software.  Like an apple: I can eat it or give it to you — but we can’t both eat the same one.
